Observed on open [PR83](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/pull/83), head `85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7`, rechecked current on 2026-11-03 at 20:05 UTC. The PR changes only dependency manifest/lock pins, including pm-cli/SDK 2026.10.28 → 2026.10.30.

## Evidence and reproduction
[Node 22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/actions/runs/41706981192/job/126164779310) and [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/actions/runs/41706981192/job/126164779654) both report 400 tests, 395 passed, 5 failed. Each failing test stops during real SDK fixture creation with `--parent must not use placeholder token "none". Use --unset parent to clear this field.`

Immutable fixture locations:
- [joint-decisions.test.ts 129–131 and 168–170](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7/test/joint-decisions.test.ts#L129): two tests initialize parent/blockedBy/goal/objective with `"none"`.
- [joint-registry.test.ts 45 and 74–76](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7/test/joint-registry.test.ts#L45): two tests use the same sentinels in create/update fixtures.
- [label-queue.test.ts 235](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7/test/label-queue.test.ts#L235): the 500-sequence test spreads a shared placeholder-field object into SDK creation.

## Goal, expected and actual
The existing [joint-decision goal](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7/.agents/pm/features/pm-jev-79ht.toon) and [label-queue goal](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/85f7dc5daab3cf5a90a3554ebe242206033947f7/.agents/pm/features/pm-jev-h8hx.toon), together with these tests, require real native-state, registry, replay and zero-mutation evidence.

Expected: upgraded fixtures create the intended root/no-relationship items using the typed SDK contract and execute the full behavioral assertions. Actual: setup is rejected before those assertions; the dependency candidate is not certified merely because production files are unchanged. The current default remains SDK 10.28, so this report does not attribute the failure to that default or claim a shipped runtime mutation defect.

## Acceptance
Migrate all affected create/update fixture clears to the supported explicit-unset contract without weakening native SDK readback, registry, 500-sequence replay or byte-preservation assertions. Retain real nonempty parent/relationship positive controls. Run both Node 22/26 full suites and unchanged coverage gates on the final head, and show that all five regressions reach their intended behavioral assertions.

## Scope and deduplication
This is hosted CI evidence plus immutable-source inspection, not a locally repeated package suite. No provider calls or source tracker writes were performed for this review. All 83 current all-status GitHub issues/PRs, PR83 discussion and all current canonical tracker records were checked. Existing `pm-jev-6fs0` owns the separate SDK 10.28 typed missing-source/fallback tests, not these SDK 10.30 placeholder setup failures.
SDK 2026.10.30 upgrade aborts five native-state regressions on placeholder parent fixtures
